content: The repository already freezes a qualification manifest, hashes immutable traffic, requires exact counter equality, zero strict failures, complete interruption rows, exact pairing, resource metrics, and recomputable latency summaries. Phase 03.2 should reuse that evidence architecture with a count-based composite gate: preserve first failure, classify setup versus product, allow one targeted correction, clean-boot rerun the affected gate, then pass only with every applicable row closed and no stuck-key defect.
